---
title: "NFL Quarterback Passing Report"
author: "Shihan Liu, Yujing Liu, Jitong Jiang, Kyurhi Kim"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE)
settings <- config::get(file = "config.yml")
```

## Overview

This report summarizes passing performance among quarterbacks
(Pos = QB) in the supplied NFL dataset.

## Descriptive Statistics

The table summarizes age, passing attempts, passing yards,
touchdowns, interceptions, and completion percentage.

```{r summary-table, results='asis'}
table_file <- "output/tables/yujing_summary.csv"

if (file.exists(table_file)) {
  summary_table <- read.csv(table_file, check.names = FALSE)
  print(knitr::kable(summary_table, digits = 2))
} else {
  cat("Summary table pending.")
}
```

## Quarterback Rankings

The chart displays up to `r settings$top_n` quarterbacks
with the highest total passing yards.

```{r ranking-chart, out.width='100%'}
ranking_file <- "output/figures/jitong_rankings.png"

if (file.exists(ranking_file)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(ranking_file), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Ranking chart pending.")
}
```

## Passing Attempts and Passing Yards

The scatterplot shows passing attempts on the horizontal axis
and passing yards on the vertical axis. Each point represents
one quarterback.

```{r relationship-chart, out.width='100%'}
scatter_file <- "output/figures/kyurhi_relationship.png"

if (file.exists(scatter_file)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(scatter_file), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Scatterplot pending.")
}
```
